test_unscoped_enum: test pybind11 unscoped enum bindings for name, value, members, comparison, ordering, and arithmetic operations
test_scoped_enum: test pybind11 scoped enum bindings for ordering and verify int comparisons always return False
test_implicit_conversion: test pybind11 class-scoped unscoped enum implicit conversion and hashing behavior in Python dicts

test_enum_to_int: test pybind11 enum to integer conversion across int, uint, and long long types
